models.sql: SELECT d.Strings AS Model, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCSYSTEM') AS Systems, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCSPACEHEATER') AS SpaceHeaters, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCPIPESEGMENT') AS PipeSegments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCDUCTSEGMENT') AS DuctSegments, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCAIRTERMINAL') AS AirTerminals, count(*) FILTER (WHERE t.Category = 'IFCSANITARYTERMINAL') AS SanitaryTerminals FROM EntityText t JOIN Entities e ON e.rowid = t.EntityIndex JOIN Documents doc ON doc.rowid = e.Document JOIN Strings d ON d.rowid = doc.Title GROUP BY d.Strings ORDER BY d.Strings
